svg.title: Fintra — AI Request Flow
svg.desc: The 12-stage AI pipeline: request intake, context and routing, AI execution via the gateway and OpenRouter, then streaming, post-processing and persistence.
svg.text: One assistant turn, end to end — the pipeline implemented by chatService + the AI Gateway. See 03-system-architecture/ai-architecture.md.
Auto mode classifies intent → tier; never selects retired models
Upstream models — one contract, many providers
provider 5xx → fallback chain · breaker opens after 5 failures / 5 min
persist-then-render: the UI never shows an unpersisted answer
